find_email.description: Find a person's email address from their name and company. Choose Professional to find a work email or Personal to find a personal one. Returns the best address plus any others found, each with a validity status.
find_email.name: find_email

parameters.description: The person's full name, for example "Saarth Shah".
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: The company the person works at, for example "Sixtyfour". Helps identify the right person.
parameters.name: company

parameters.description: Optional. The person's job title, for example "CEO". Improves match accuracy.
parameters.name: title

parameters.description: Optional. The person's LinkedIn profile URL. The most reliable way to pin down the exact person.
parameters.name: linkedin_url

parameters.description: Which kind of email to look for. Professional finds a work email; Personal finds a personal email (and costs more Sixtyfour credits).
parameters.name: mode

find_phone.description: Find a person's phone number from their name and company. Adding a job title or LinkedIn URL improves the match. Returns the best number plus any others found.
find_phone.display_str_template: Find a phone number for {0} at {1}.
find_phone.name: find_phone

parameters.description: The person's full name, for example "Saarth Shah".
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: The company the person works at, for example "Sixtyfour". Helps identify the right person.
parameters.name: company

parameters.description: Optional. The person's job title, for example "CEO". Improves match accuracy.
parameters.name: title
